findings.source_passage: as I sat there at my ease, cross-legged on the deck; after the bitter exertion at the windlass; under a blue tranquil sky; the ship under indolent sail
findings.source_locator: paragraph 4, opening of the long anaphoric sentence
findings.why_it_matters: The full anaphoric roll-call of the setting ('after the bitter exertion at the windlass; under a blue tranquil sky…woven almost within the hour') is a prosodically and rhetorically distinctive Melvillean period; the draft drops 'after the bitter exertion at the windlass' and the phrase 'woven almost within the hour,' severing the deliberate rhythmic buildup that makes the passage famous.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full opening clause of this anaphoric sentence verbatim, including 'after the bitter exertion at the windlass' and 'woven almost within the hour,' so the rhetorical build-up to the meadow vision survives intact.

findings.source_passage: It had cooled and crystallized to such a degree…I sat down before a large Constantine's bath of it
findings.why_it_matters: 'A large Constantine's bath' is a distinctive period-specific allusion (the Baths of Constantine) that gives the scene its mock-classical grandeur; the draft replaces it with 'a great bath,' erasing a textually distinctive phrase.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'Constantine's bath' verbatim; it is part of the signature register of this paragraph.

findings.source_passage: first comes white-horse…It is tough with congealed tendons—a wad of muscle…They look much like blocks of Berkshire marble.
findings.why_it_matters: The white-horse description—its specific location on the fish, its texture ('wad of muscle'), and the simile to Berkshire marble—is the only substantive account of this substance; the draft names 'white-horse' but gives none of this, stripping it to a bare label.
findings.suggested_fix: Add at minimum 'tough with congealed tendons—a wad of muscle' and the Berkshire marble simile; these supply the signature descriptive texture the passage requires.

findings.source_passage: Now, while discoursing of sperm, it behooves to speak of other things akin to it…First comes white-horse…Plum-pudding is the term bestowed…There is another substance…Gurry, so called…Nippers.
findings.source_locator: catalogue paragraphs, middle section of source
findings.why_it_matters: Melville's catalogue of whale-processing substances is structured as a mock-encyclopaedic glossary, each entry given its own paragraph with full definitional apparatus—a voice-establishing stylistic tic. The draft collapses all entries into a single breathless run-on, erasing the mock-lexicographic form that is itself the signature.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore distinct paragraph breaks and at least skeletal definitional sentences for each term (slobgollion, gurry, nippers) so the encyclopaedic form—not just the vocabulary—is recognisable.

findings.source_passage: It is called slobgollion; an appellation original with the whalemen…It is an ineffably oozy, stringy affair…I hold it to be the wondrously thin, ruptured membranes of the case, coalescing.
findings.why_it_matters: The closing conjecture—'I hold it to be the wondrously thin, ruptured membranes of the case, coalescing'—is Ishmael's characteristic pseudo-scientific speculation and is fully absent from the draft, which gives only the adjectives 'oozy, stringy.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'I hold it to be the wondrously thin, ruptured membranes of the case, coalescing' to preserve the speculative-naturalist voice.

findings.source_passage: Nippers…by nameless blandishments, as of magic, allures along with it all impurities.
findings.why_it_matters: The playful personification—'nameless blandishments, as of magic'—is erased; the draft reduces nippers to 'leathern squilgees of tail,' keeping only the functional gloss.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain 'by nameless blandishments, as of magic, allures along with it all impurities' to preserve the whimsical register of the glossary entries.

summary: The draft preserves the famous 'Squeeze! squeeze! squeeze!' paragraph and the angels-in-paradise close faithfully, but drops 'Constantine's bath,' truncates the anaphoric wind-up to the meadow vision, collapses the mock-encyclopaedic catalogue structure, and loses key signature phrases in white-horse, slobgollion, and nippers—amounting to one high-severity and four medium-severity failures that together warrant regeneration.
